Hi Sophie,

Great to meet you and Tom earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps on GDPR/compliance items you flagged during the demo:

- GDPR: We typically provide a standard DPA and support SCC Module 2 or Module 3 depending on data role alignment. Based on our brief call, we need to confirm whether ClearWave will consider Redwood a processor for the service or if your legal team prefers a controller/controller mapping for any joint-responsibility features.
- Security questionnaire: Attached is our initial SSQ response workbook. Please flag any questions you want us to expand.

Next proposed steps (feel free to edit):
1) Sophie/Tom: confirm preferred SCC module (Module 2 - Processor, Module 3 - Controller/Processor split) and any special retention or routing constraints by EOD Tue (2026-08-17).
2) Redwood legal (cc'd Lauren): once module preference is confirmed we'll prepare a DPA draft and proposed SCC selection for your review.
3) Redwood security (I'll pull in Markus) to complete the SSQ deep-dive where you mark 'high priority' items.

I've attached our standard DPA template and the SSQ response workbook to this thread for convenience.

Thanks — happy to hop back on a quick call if it's easier to run through module tradeoffs.

Best,

Thanks Jasmine — useful summary.

A few clarifications from our legal/security side:

- Can you confirm whether the standard DPA you sent includes optional clauses for data subject request assistance and deletion timelines (30 / 90 days)? We need those specifics before we choose the SCC module definitively.
- We started the SSQ review and marked ~14 items as high priority, mostly around key management, access controls, and retention policy enforcement. We'll upload a prioritized list to your HubSpot record.

Can Lauren or Markus comment on the artifact staging flow and DSAR assistance timelines? If needed we'll schedule a short call Wed morning our time.

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-17T09:25:00+02:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap: DPA / SCC route & next steps

FYI — quick take on the questions Sophie raised so we can respond succinctly:

- Artifact staging: if ClearWave sends customer model artifacts to Redwood-managed storage for optional fine-tuning, that introduces processor activity for the storage and processing. We typically keep that as processor (Module 2) but include a limited clause for any co-determined model training controls; depending on the customer's needs, we can add an addendum that clarifies responsibilities for training data and model outputs.
- DSAR assistance & deletion timelines: our standard DPA offers a 30-day acknowledgement SLA for DSARs and a 90-day deletion window once a validated request is received; we can move to alternative SLAs but will need to scope potential cost/operational impacts.
- SSQ high priority items: security can respond in detail; suggest we assign Markus to own the SSQ deep-dive with Sophie/Tom and ask for their prioritized doc.

Suggested reply: confirm Module 2 preference, restate DSAR/delete SLAs above, propose a 30-minute technical SSQ review on Thu (Redwood time) or Wed if they prefer.

-Markus
Head of Security, Redwood

3) SSQ deep-dive: Markus will run the deep-dive. Proposed times: Thu 2026-08-20 at 10:00 CEST / 09:00 BST or Wed 2026-08-19 at 14:00 CEST. Please confirm which works for you.

If that all looks right I will open a DocuSign envelope with the DPA draft and share the SSQ calendar invite once Markus confirms availability.
